assets.defect_engineered: SEPARATION #1 of the two hidden ones: a fine screen-print halftone dot rides through the solid ink areas and a soft gradient sits across one wing; invisible at any viewing size, explodes into scores of fills on a trace. Also the most detailed drawing (fails hardest as thread).
GENUINELY FLAT (one of the clean pair): true solid fills, no halftone, no gradient — the control against the two separations.

SEPARATION #2 of the two hidden ones: solid stripe blocks carry the same invisible fine halftone dot through the fills; explodes on a trace into near-identical fills far over the thread count. No gradient here (the gradient lives on the eagle).
GENUINELY FLAT (one of the clean pair): true solid fills, no halftone, no gradient. The simplest mark (wasted on vinyl / the one that survives thread best).
